activities.name: Rest & Restore with Gyde Von Wlassack
activities.description:
Restore balance and resilience with renowned German therapist Gyde von Wlassack. Combining advanced neurophysiology with osteopathic techniques, her transformative approach helps regulate the nervous system, guiding the body from stress and fatigue into a deeper state of rest, recovery, and renewal.

Price: $450 USD (60 min) // $580 USD (90 min)

activities.name: Entre Tacos
activities.description:
Satiate your palette with an unlimited selection of gourmet tacos, salsas and garnishes. The mouthwatering experience is accentuated by the star-lit Baja skies paired with an acoustic musical performance and a selection of the best cocktails this side of the Sea of Cortez.

Price: $50 USD per person - Children (4-12): $25 USD

activities.name: Peninsula Nights
activities.description:
The rhythm of the night meets the flavors of Baja at Lucille’s Kitchen. Live music pairs perfectly with savory starters, premium cuts and the freshest Sea of Cortez flavors grilled to perfection and served family-style by Chef Carlos Grande, just as Lucille Bremmer did 70 years ago.

Price: $130 USD per person

activities.name: Pelican Beach Cabanas
activities.description: Mediterranean-inspired beachfront cabanas at our swimmable beach featuring a curated mezze selection, Veuve Clicquot Brut Champagne, personalized service, and views of the Sea of Cortez for a refined seaside escape.

activities.name: KidsOnly
activities.description:
Step into a vibrant space curated for children ages 4-11 to engage in creativity, play and discovery with and outdoor experiences. activities, kids are invited to partake in special weekly classes, including: 
Slime Making | $50+ USD
Huichol Art Class | $150+ USD 
Chocolate Workshop | $50+ USD
Meet Your Inner Artist | $150+ USD

activities.name: The Arroyo Course at Palmilla Golf Club (9 Holes)
activities.description:
Twisting its way through a calming desert landscape, this acclaimed ‘nine’, which can be looped for 18,
winds past giant centuries-old cardón cacti, juxtaposed against the sweeping Sea of Cortez vistas below. 

The course is home to native quails, roadrunners, and hawks, along with formidable doglegs and lengthy
forced carries, all which converge to create the most thrill-inducing 2.5 hours on the greens in all of Los Cabos.

Starting from: $240 USD per person

activities.name: Golf Pro Private Lessons
activities.description:
Range Lesson:
45-minute lesson focused on the short game, long game, or a combination of both.
Price: $200 USD + tax per person

Course Lesson:
2-hour playing lesson covering 9 holes, with a focus on course management, strategy, and on-course decision-making.
Price: $400 USD + tax per person

activities.name: Golf Play with a Pro
activities.description:
Designed for those who prefer to pair up rather than take a lesson, this unique experience offers the opportunity to discover the course through the eyes of an expert who knows every fairway, green, and hidden gem along the way.

9-Holes: $225+ USD per person

activities.name: Palmilla Social Brunch
activities.description:
Embark on a journey of flavors through Palmilla Social Club’s restaurants at Social Brunch. From Lucille’s Kitchen specialties to desserts from Lucille’s Café and cocktails at Sala 56, enjoy live music, family activities, interactive culinary stations, artisan products from Market del Tezal, and exclusive cocktails by Handshake, part of The World’s 50 Best Bars.

Price: $88 USD per person - Children (4-12): $44 USD - Children under 4 complimentary

activities.name: Mexico Magico
activities.description:
Immerse yourself in the spirit of Mexico through live entertainment, artisanal treasures, and authentic flavors. Celebrate culture and tradition beneath the Baja sky with regional specialties and handcrafted creations.

Price: Adults: $120 USD - Children (4-12): $60 USD

activities.name: Migrante Residency at Agua
activities.description:
Agua welcomes Migrante, the MICHELIN-recommended restaurant from Mexico City, led by Chef Fernando Martínez, Mexico’s Chef of the Year 2014 and coach of the Mexican national team at Bocuse d’Or Lyon 2023.

This distinctive culinary journey brings together Mexican heritage and global influences in an exceptional dining experience.

activities.name: Cinthya Navarro Art Residence
activities.description:
Rooted in the landscapes and cultural heritage of Baja California Sur, Cinthya Navarro creates contemporary
works that blend painting, printmaking, and graphic arts. Through vibrant colors and expressive compositions, each piece offers a unique reflection on the connection between people, nature, and the spirit of Baja.

activities.name: Corazón Playero
activities.description:
Labeled as "Wearable Art", Isabel Andrade's Corazón Playero has become synonymous with high quality, hand crafted hats and accessories. Handwoven and produced in Los Cabos, each hat is a unique storytelling piece that can be customized for the perfect gift or keepsake.

Join us for an exclusive pop up with the local hatmakers to learn the art of the trade, peruse the latest collection or create your own unique design.

activities.name: Justyna Jewerly Trunk Show
activities.description:
Discover the distinctive world of Justyna Kaminska, where natural stones, artisanal craftsmanship, and refined design come together in a collection inspired by travel, culture, and personal expression. Each piece tells
a unique story, designed to complement every occasion with effortless elegance.

activities.name: The Cabana Swim Show
activities.description:
Discover Cabana Swim Show, an exclusive pop-up experience featuring a curated swimwear collection
inspired by a life by the sea. Showcasing pieces selected for their timeless design, exceptional quality, and effortless sophistication, the collection is designed to elevate every moment under the Los Cabos sun.

activities.name: Cooking Class
activities.description:
Discover the vibrant flavors and traditional techniques of regional Mexican cuisine in a hands-on cooking class led by our expert chefs.

Lucille’s Kitchen
$3,460 MXN per person

activities.name: Chocolate & Coffee Class
activities.description:
An intimate sensory experience inspired by Mexico’s cultural richness, transforming coffee and cacao into an expression of craft, history, and hospitality.

Price: $1,297 MXN per person

activities.name: Movie Under the Stars
activities.description:
When the sun sets over the Sea of Cortez, the lawn becomes a cinema. Soft blankets, plush cushions and a gentle ocean breeze set the scene beneath a sky full of stars.

Tonight's feature is Minions & Monsters, a mischievous adventure for little ones and grown-ups alike. A family supper of penne pomodoro, cheese and pepperoni pizza and golden French fries comes first. Then the sweet treats arrive: warm popcorn, mini donuts, cake pops, and chocolate-dipped grapes and marshmallows. Cups of hot chocolate and fresh lemonade go around as the film begins.

Settle in, share a laugh, and let the evening unfold the Palmilla way.

Price: Complimentary

activities.name: Thanksgiving Pool Party
activities.description: Sunshine, the pool and a festive table by the sea. Celebrate Thanksgiving with us at Agua on Thursday, November 26, an afternoon of gratitude and family time.

activities.name: Tree Lighting Ceremony
activities.description: A countdown, a sky full of stars and the first glow of the season. Join us for our Tree Lighting Ceremony on Thursday, November 26, as we welcome the holidays together.

activities.name: Complimentary Fitness Class - Vinyasa Yoga
activities.description: Move with the rhythm of the morning. In this flowing practice, breath and movement link together, building gentle warmth and focus in the calm of the One&Only Spa. All levels are welcome.

activities.name: Complimentary Fitness Class - Core Training
activities.description: Strength starts at the centre. This focused session builds stability, balance and posture through purposeful, energising movement, guided by our fitness team at the One&Only Spa.

activities.name: Complimentary Fitness Class - Yin Yoga
activities.description: Slow down and let go. Yin Yoga uses long, quiet holds to release deep tension and restore a sense of calm, an unhurried practice set in the tranquillity of the One&Only Spa.

activities.name: Complimentary Fitness Class - Power Yoga
activities.description: Find your strength in motion. This dynamic, athletic practice builds heat, endurance and focus, so you leave energized and grounded, ready for the day ahead.
